title: Noor ki anjuman Fatema
body:
Noor ki anjuman Fatema
Noor ki anjuman faatima
markaze panjetan faatima
1. Arsh se ban ke aayi hai tu
murtaza ki dulhan faatema
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kehkasha se zyaada hasee
tere ghar kaa chaman faatema
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Khuld ka arsh par hai dimaa
chu ke tere charan faatima
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kab kisi maa ne paida kiye
fir hussaino hasan faatima
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ban gaya tera baaghe fidak
ghaasibo ka kafan faatima
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Boli zainab se ruhe ali
sar utha aur ban faatima
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hai yeh qaule nabi ai sarosh
mera tan mera man faatema
author: Mir Hassan Mir
